statutory_text: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When approaching the crest of a grade or upon a curve in the highway where the driver’s view is obstructed within such distance as to create a hazard in the event another vehicle might approach from the opposite direction. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.
